howToApply: Visit the official website www.psc.cg.gov.in and click on the active application link available during the notified dates.

Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and email ID.
Upload a live photo using the link sent to your registered mobile number (ensure face is clear, both ears visible, eyes open, light-colored background).
Upload your signature (sign on white paper with black ballpoint pen, scan as .JPG file, max 100 KB).
After uploading photo and signature, click ‘Save’ and then click ‘Apply’ for the advertised post from your dashboard.
Fill in all required details carefully in the online application form.
Pay the application fee and portal charges online using Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or other available modes.
After successful payment, download and print the application receipt and payment receipt for future reference.
Ensure Application Status shows ‘Submitted’ and Payment Status shows ‘Paid’ on the acknowledgment page.
Previously registered candidates can log in using their existing Login ID and Password.
